surprises.head: Vancouver won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Edmonton, 3.7 to 2.3, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Vancouver tried a different line
surprises.body: B. Boeser, L. Ohgren, M. Rossi played 10:45 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Vancouver’s usual lines.

surprises.head: Edmonton tried a different line
surprises.body: K. Kapanen, L. Draisaitl, V. Podkolzin played 12:14 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Edmonton’s usual lines.
